Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and including Jordan's preferred tea show attentiveness, but the encouragement followed a group reminder and the tea was one of several drink options.
Three extended texting exchanges containing personal updates support interpersonal interest, though their mixture with group topics does not clearly distinguish romantic interest from friendship.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains modestly better supported. HB-F1 through HB-F3 provide meaningful but ambiguous evidence for A. HB-F4 shows that Alex is broadly warm and also makes one-on-one plans with others, while HB-F5 contains no explicit romantic indication and HB-F6 lacks a concrete rescheduling effort. The reconsidered evidence lowers confidence in B but does not make A or genuine indeterminacy the strongest category.
